links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM patient education responses versus recommended sixth- to eighth-grade level
links.effect: Median Gunning Fog and Coleman-Liau scores for all four models exceeded the commonly recommended sixth- to eighth-grade reading level; Grok 4 produced the most difficult text.
links.quote: The median Gunning Fog and Coleman-Liau scores for all four models exceeded the commonly recommended sixth- to eighth-grade reading level for patient education.

links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient-oriented responses in plain language
links.effect: Readability differed significantly among models across all three indices; median Gunning Fog and Coleman-Liau exceeded the recommended sixth- to eighth-grade level for all four models.
links.quote: The median Gunning Fog and Coleman-Liau scores for all four models exceeded the commonly recommended sixth- to eighth-grade reading level for patient education.

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the quality (DISCERN) and readability of several LLM responses to patient FAQs about patellofemoral pain syndrome without testing a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
